title: Upscaled Supplementaries 32x
body:
Upscaled Supplementaries 32x is a [Faithful](https://faithfulpack.net/)\-style resource pack that provides higher-resolution textures for Supplementaries mod. It enhances visual clarity while preserving the original style, offering a sharper and more detailed 32×32 look.


![](https://imgur.com/X9GtrkW.png) ![](https://imgur.com/MwkHOX1.png)

### **Credits** * [Faithful 32x](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/faithful-32x) - Some textures from this pack were based on Faithful 32x
